SpaceX quarterly revenue surges past estimates driven by AI business

articles.headline: SpaceX Quarterly Revenue Surges on AI Business Growth
articles.brief: SpaceX reported a significant jump in quarterly revenue, beating Wall Street estimates as its artificial intelligence business continues to experience rapid growth and commercial expansion.

articles.headline: Salesforce Deepens AI Bets With $5.66 Billion Braze Deal
articles.brief: Salesforce has announced a major strategic acquisition of Braze valued at $5.66 billion, deepening its footprint in the enterprise artificial intelligence and customer engagement sector.

articles.headline: AstraZeneca-Amgen Asthma Drug Hits 69% Remission in Trial
articles.brief: Clinical trial results show an AstraZeneca and Amgen asthma treatment achieved a 69 percent remission rate in patients suffering from a severe esophageal disease, marking a major medical milestone.

articles.headline: Iran Tells Pakistan No Washington Talks Until Demands Met
articles.brief: Tehran has informed the visiting Pakistan army chief that it will refuse any direct negotiations with Washington until its specific regional and economic demands are fully satisfied.

articles.headline: NATO to Send Aircraft and Drones to Black Sea
articles.brief: Following a series of security incidents and attacks on commercial shipping, NATO announced plans to deploy additional surveillance planes and drones to monitor and protect the Black Sea region.

articles.headline: Marco Rubio Says US and India Very Close to Trade Deal
articles.brief: During an official visit to India, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that both nations are very close to finalizing a comprehensive bilateral trade agreement following productive diplomatic talks.

articles.headline: PM Modi Calls for National Unity During Vijayadashami
articles.brief: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged citizens to identify and defeat forces working against India, emphasizing self-reliance and collective strength during national Vijayadashami celebrations.

articles.headline: Rubio Encourages Reliance to Refine Venezuelan Oil
articles.brief: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with officials to encourage India's Reliance Industries to increase the production and refining of Venezuelan crude under modified sanctions frameworks.

articles.headline: Volkswagen Faces Major Setbacks in China Strategy With Xpeng
articles.brief: Volkswagen's strategic investment and partnership with Chinese EV maker Xpeng to salvage its declining market share in China is reportedly facing severe execution hurdles.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Slams Misplaced Sympathy in Long Trials
articles.brief: The Supreme Court has strongly criticized the Allahabad High Court for letting off convicted offenders on probation merely due to lengthy trial durations, calling it a miscarriage of justice.

articles.headline: Delhi Airport Records Highest First-Half Passenger Traffic
articles.brief: Indira Gandhi International Airport in New Delhi handled a record 38.5 million passengers in the first half of the fiscal year, prompting plans for accelerated capacity expansion.

articles.headline: Centre Reviews National Mineral Policy for Critical Minerals
articles.brief: The Ministry of Mines has constituted a specialized committee to overhaul the National Mineral Policy, placing renewed emphasis on critical mineral security, recycling, and industry modernization.

articles.headline: Ranji Trophy Round Two Day Three Matches Continue
articles.brief: Domestic cricket action intensified across various venues as teams battled through pivotal third-day encounters in the second round of the prestigious Ranji Trophy tournament.
